title: Which rule wins, and why it is not order
ground: Two rules set the same property on the same element. One is written two hundred lines later than the other.
task: Given six selector pairs, compute both specificity triples, name the winner, and name the column that decided it. Then find the pair where the loser would win under @layer and explain what changed.

rubric.test: Are all six correct, including the :has(), :is() and :where() cases?
Does the answer name which of a, b or c decided it, rather than only the winner?
Does the explanation put layers BEFORE specificity in the cascade order, rather than treating them as a tiebreak?
